resources.string: By signing up for or using the Entorno platform, you agree to comply with these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with any of the clauses, you must not access the app.
Entorno is a collaborative platform for reporting community and safety incidents. You agree to post only truthful, respectful and constructive information about events in your neighborhood.
Posting false or defamatory information, hate speech, harassing content or misleading material is strictly prohibited. Breaking this rule may lead moderators to permanently suspend your account.
Authorized moderators will review reports and award badges or points based on how truthful and useful the information provided is.
We reserve the right to update these terms at any time. We will notify you of significant changes through the app.
To provide our community safety services, we collect your name, email, city, address and geolocation coordinates when you submit reports in your area.
Your data is used only to validate your posts, show relevant reports in your neighborhood through interactive maps and send important notifications about the status of your incidents.
All your information is protected by Firebase Cloud Firestore security protocols and Firebase Auth encrypted authentication.
We do not sell or trade your personal data with third parties. Community reports are public, either anonymously or with the user\'s name, for the common good of the neighborhood.
You can update or delete your data at any time from your profile settings or by requesting that your account be deleted.
